en.title: Maximum Chocolates Without Taking Adjacent Jars
en.description:
Each jar holds a non-negative integer number of chocolates. Take some jars from a row of jars, without taking two adjacent jars, and find the maximum number of chocolates. You may take no jars at all.

See the input protocol for this site's supplements to missing ranges and its recovery of typos in the source.
en.input: First n is given, then n non-negative counts. The original bound 1≤n≤1000 is kept. The original upper bound on values is missing; this site adds 0..10^9 and does not adopt the unsourced cap of 10000 from the catalog.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 10; 1; 0. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Maintain rolling best values for the first i−2 jars and the first i−1 jars; the current jar is either skipped or added to the best value for the first i−2 jars.
